findings.title: Making `.small-action` a flex container stops `float: right` on its button from working.
findings.body: Once `.small-action` is `display: flex`, `float` has no effect on its children. The `button { float: right; }` rule (and `float: left` on `.topic-avatar`) is ignored. The button now sits in DOM order right after `.small-action-desc` instead of at the right edge, or on the left if it comes first in the template. `.small-action-desc` also has no `flex-grow`, so nothing pushes the button to the right. Fix: add `margin-left: auto` to the button (or `flex: 1` to `.small-action-desc`), and set `order` if the button comes first in the markup.

held.title: A long topic title in the flex header can overflow and push the panel out of view.
held.body: `.extra-info-wrapper` is now a flex item in `.contents` with the default `min-width: auto`, so it cannot shrink below the width of its content. When the docked header shows a long topic title, the wrapper takes its full text width. That can push `.panel` (`margin-left: auto`, `order: 3`) off-screen or onto a new line, and any `text-overflow: ellipsis` on the title stops truncating. I couldn't see the rest of this element's styles to confirm. Fix: add `min-width: 0` (and `flex: 1 1 auto` or `overflow: hidden`) to `.extra-info-wrapper`.
